svg.title: MARIBOR / LEVEL LAYOUT
svg.text: Blender environment reference + editable construction proposal / no meshes or Unity scenes delivered
Full-level image is not a scale drawing.
A / Tabor: facade-lined car slalom, two larger
melee groups and a car-ramp escape.
B / Lent: flat river plane, two narrow riding
paths, bridge silhouette and ranged Watchers.
C / Podzemni prehod: fence opening, closing door,
Guilt at far end and a side escape opening.
All variants reach one FERI sign/transition; no
water crossing or new travel mechanic.
Continuous curb ramps on the ride lane; perimeter
Cars use simple boxes; ramp traversal uses a
C side escape must connect to the shared exit, not
Filter City gates from saved Forest choice and
ExitCity saves City C for NEXT RUN and transitions
Watch changes toward 07:59 at the end of the city.
Regular enemy cap 12; instantiate small groups
rather than all routes at once.
Meters; Unity +Y up. Floor modules originate on finished floor Y = 0.
Separate render geometry, simple collision and semantic markers.
4 m bays and all new dimensions are proposals; test actual player/camera.
Use floorplans/city-topology.svg for the full connected branch plan.
The setting evokes Maribor; these routes are not a geographical reconstruction. Timings require later playtesting.
